## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry limit should be corrected because the new helper exceeds the maximum required by project policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry` with configurable attempts and delay, plus tests for recovery, exhaustion and attempt limits. It also proposes raising the documented retry cap to ten.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Restore the five-attempt retry cap — When an upstream repeatedly raises `OSError`, the default call makes ten attempts, violating AGENTS.md:5: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” The validator also accepts explicit limits above five. — During an upstream outage, callers exceed the permitted request budget and wait through additional fetch timeouts. — Fix: Cap the default and validation at five, and align the docstring and attempt-limit tests.
